visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide eye-level shot of a bustling street in Hsinchu, showing a person walking away from the camera. The sky is overcast. Then, three young people—two women and one man—are seen in a narrow, dimly lit alley, huddled together and intently looking at a smartphone screen. One woman has a bun and wears a white vest over a black top; the man has short hair and a blue bag; the third woman has long brown hair and a black jacket. (2) Close-up shots feature hands holding a blue game kit box titled "塹裡尋妖" and various cards with anime character illustrations. The setting shifts to an indoor hallway with life-sized anime character standees, then outdoors to the Hsinchu Train Station under bright daylight. The trio poses with V-signs, wearing name tags. (3) A fast-paced montage shows the three running through various urban locations, including a traditional temple with ornate gold and red decorations. They are seen praying with eyes closed and hands pressed together. They use props like maps and photos to solve puzzles. Lighting transitions from natural daylight to warm, low indoor lights. (4) The visuals alternate between real-world footage and digital game interface screenshots with anime characters and dialogue boxes. Finally, the trio is in a brightly lit studio setting with a clean background, holding pink and blue cardboard signs with variety-style text while smiling and gesturing at the camera.

(2) A "whoosh" sound effect marks a transition. The narrator speaks at a rapid conversational pace with clear articulation. The BGM maintains high energy with heavy bass kicks. A subtle "ding" sound effect plays when a physical game kit appears in the mix. (3) The acoustic texture shifts as the speech density increases. A comedic "boing" or cartoon-style SFX punctuates a moment of humor in the narration. The BGM tempo remains steady, providing a constant energetic bed. (4) Narration maintains high valence and positive affect. Several "pop" UI sound effects are synced with on-screen graphic changes. The BGM reaches a slight peak in spectral brightness before the final assertive call-to-action phrase from the narrator, followed by a quick audio fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction -> Gameplay Experience -> Cultural Context -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the immersive outdoor reality game '塹裡尋妖' in Hsinchu City by showcasing its anime-inspired visuals, puzzle-solving mechanics, and its ability to connect players with local history and culture. The video aims to drive sales and awareness for the game and the associated Hsinchu International Animation & Comics Festival.
